transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora, your clinical conversational agent. I'm here to help you with any questions you might have about your cataract surgery or recovery. Do you have any questions for me today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful, thank you! My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thanks for the information. I'm also very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. However, if you're experiencing significant pain, severe light sensitivity, or if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, that makes sense. Lastly, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for your vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. This should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you so much for your help, Dora!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! So, just to confirm, all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered everything I needed to know. Thanks again for your assistance!
